macro.headline: ASX Navigates Geopolitical Heat and 'Higher for Longer' Rate Fears Amid Sticky Inflation
themes: Geopolitical Risk Premium: Persistent US-Iran tensions and broader Middle East instability keep crude oil and LNG prices elevated, bolstering energy stocks and safe-haven demand for gold.

Sticky Inflation & Hawkish Central Banks: Latest inflation data (globally) suggests persistent price pressures, leading the RBA and Fed to maintain a 'higher for longer' interest rate stance, dampening growth expectations.

Commodity Divergence: Energy and gold remain strong tailwinds, benefiting from geopolitical risk and inflation hedging, while iron ore faces headwinds from ongoing, albeit somewhat stimulated, weakness in China's property sector.
